text: At 2.1.88 the two criteria read "every brief (patch) operation with `direct` in the `internal` channel has an mcp-tool entity with server brief-tools (patch-tools)". Taken literally they fail: `list_briefs` and `list_patches` are `internal: direct`, and their records name `transagent-tools-list-briefs` / `transagent-tools-list-patches` as their internal tools, not a brief-tools / patch-tools entity (M23 m23mcp01 says the same for list_patches). Built as: an operation "of a brief" / "of a patch" addresses ONE artifact; the set operations rendered by the orchestrator are outside the criterion. Please narrow the titles (e.g. "every operation on one brief …" or "… except the set operations rendered on transagent-tools"), so they do not contradict the list records.
assumption: ASSUMPTION:dev-brief-patch-threads-set-operations: list_briefs / list_patches (set operations, internal on transagent-tools) are outside "operations of a brief/patch" in ac-kazda-operacja-briefu-renderowana-w-k / ac-kazda-operacja-patcha-z-wartoscia-dir.
